(6 May) |longest wins = |longest unbeaten = |longest losses = |highest attendance = |lowest attendance = |average attendance = |prevseason=[[2022 Venezuelan Primera División season|2022]] |nextseason=[[2024 Venezuelan Primera División season|2024]] }} The '''2023 Primera División season''', officially '''Liga de Fútbol Profesional Venezolano''' or '''''Liga FUTVE''''', was the 67th season of the [[Venezuelan Primera División]], the top-flight [[Association football|football]] league in Venezuela, and the 42nd season since the start of the professional era. The season began on 3 February and ended on 25 November 2023.{{cite web |url=https://www.liderendeportes.com/noticias/futbol/futve/nueva-campana-comenzara-el-2-de-febrero-con-igual-formato/ |title=Nueva campaña comenzará el 2 de febrero con igual formato |trans-title=New campaign will begin on 2 February with the same format |publisher=Líder en Deportes |language=es |date=5 January 2023 |access-date=7 January 2023}} [[Deportivo Táchira F.C.|Deportivo Táchira]] won their tenth title at the end of the season, defeating [[Caracas F.C.|Caracas]] on penalty kicks following a 1–1 draw after extra time in the final.{{cite web |url=https://www.liderendeportes.com/noticias/futbol/futve/deportivo-tachira-consigue-su-decima-estrella/ |title=Deportivo Táchira consigue su décima estrella |trans-title=Deportivo Táchira get their tenth ''star'' |publisher=Líder en Deportes |language=es |date=25 November 2023 |access-date=25 November 2023}} [[Metropolitanos F.C.|Metropolitanos]] were the defending champions. ==Format== The competition format for this season was announced by the Liga FUTVE on 31 January 2023. Similar to the previous season, the 15 participating clubs took part in a double round-robin first stage in which they played each other twice (once at home and once away) for a total of 28 games. The top four clubs, which qualified for the [[2024 Copa Libertadores]], also advanced to a final stage where they played each other twice with the top two teams playing a single-match final to decide the league champions. However, and unlike the previous season, no final stage to decide the teams qualified for the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana]] was played, with the four berths to that competition instead being awarded to the teams placing 5th to 8th in the first stage.{{cite web |url=https://www.liderendeportes.com/noticias/futbol/futve/liga-futve-tendra-un-nuevo-formato-de-competicion/ |title=Liga Futve tendrá un nuevo formato de competición |trans-title=Liga Futve will have a new competition format |publisher=Líder en Deportes |language=es |date=31 January 2023 |access-date=1 February 2023}} The team placing last in the first stage was relegated to [[Venezuelan Segunda División|Segunda División]] for the following season. ==Teams== 16 teams were expected to compete in the 2023 season, subject to the fulfillment of club licensing requirements: the top 15 teams in the first stage of the 2022 season as well as the 2022 [[Venezuelan Segunda División|Segunda División]] champions [[Angostura F.C.|Angostura]], who defeated Academia Anzoátegui in the Segunda División final on 16 October 2022.{{cite web |url=https://www.lavinotinto.com/angostura-fc-logro-el-titulo-de-la-segunda-division-y-el-ascenso/ |title=Angostura FC logró el título de la segunda división y el ascenso |trans-title=Angostura FC achieved the second division title and promotion |publisher=La Vinotinto |language=es |date=16 October 2022 |access-date=21 November 2022}} They replaced [[Aragua F.C.|Aragua]], who were relegated to Segunda División at the end of the previous season after finishing in bottom place. On 12 December 2022, it was announced that [[Zulia F.C.|Zulia]] and Segunda División side [[Deportivo Rayo Zuliano|Rayo Zuliano]] would merge, with the latter taking the former's place in the league.{{cite web |url=https://versionfinal.com.ve/xvf-portada/vf-home/extraoficial-deportivo-rayo-zuliano-y-zulia-futbol-club-conformarian-una-sola-institucion/ |title=Extraoficial: Deportivo Rayo Zuliano y Zulia Fútbol Club conformarían una sola institución |trans-title=Unofficial: Deportivo Rayo Zuliano and Zulia Fútbol Club would form a single institution |publisher=Versión Final |language=es |date=13 December 2022 |access-date=29 January 2023}} The merger was officially confirmed on 28 January 2023, with which Rayo Zuliano competed in the top flight for the first time ever in this season.{{cite web |url=https://rdnoticiasven.net/confirmaron-fusion-con-el-zulia-fc-rayo-zuliano-llego-a-primera-division-de-la-liga-futve/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230129164642/https://rdnoticiasven.net/confirmaron-fusion-con-el-zulia-fc-rayo-zuliano-llego-a-primera-division-de-la-liga-futve/ |url-status=usurped |archive-date=January 29, 2023 |title=¡CONFIRMARON FUSIÓN CON EL ZULIA FC! Rayo Zuliano llegó a primera división de la liga Futve |trans-title=THEY CONFIRMED MERGER WITH ZULIA FC! Rayo Zuliano reached the Liga Futve's first division |publisher=Red Digital Noticias |language=es |date=29 January 2023 |access-date=29 January 2023}} Furthermore, two days later it was confirmed that [[Asociación Civil Deportivo Lara|Deportivo Lara]] would not take part in the season, ultimately bringing the number of participating teams down to 15.{{cite web |url=https://www.balonazos.com/la-liga-futve-confirma-via-twitter-que-la-temporada-2023-arranca-el-3-y-que-el-dvo-lara-no-estara/ |title=La Liga FutVe confirma vía Twitter que la temporada 2023 arranca el 3 y que el Dvo Lara no estará |trans-title=Liga FutVe confirms via Twitter that the 2023 season kicks off on the 3rd and that Dvo Lara will not be there |publisher=Balonazos |language=es |date=30 January 2023 |access-date=31 January 2023}}{{cite web |url=https://www.federacionvenezolanadefutbol.org/fvf-anuncia-listado-de-clubes-que-han-obtenido-su-licencia-para-el-2023/ |title=FVF anuncia listado de clubes que han obtenido su licencia para el 2023 |trans-title=FVF announces list of clubs that have obtained their license for 2023 |publisher=[[Venezuelan Football Federation|FVF]] |language=es |date=31 January 2023 |access-date=31 January 2023}} {{Location map+ |Venezuela |float=right |width=450 |caption=Locations of the 2023 Primera División teams |places= {{Location map~ |Venezuela |lat=10.46840 |long=-68.0100 |label=
